summary_claims.claim: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 added to footnote 26 of Act 56/2018; Articles 36 and 45 cited for authorised bodies
Fine under Article 99(4)(f) in new section 28(6); report to the Commission in section 29(1)(h)

scope.note: Omnibus amendment of the conformity-assessment act; included because it adds Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 to the notified-body regime and sets fines under Article 99 of the AI Act.

note: Act 318/2025 text confirms number, dates and the AI Act provisions (points 17, 22, 61, 69). Entry into force 1 January 2026. A later Act 88/2026 amends Act 56/2018, not this act, so the status holds. Borderline scope note suggested.
